findings.title: Unresolved high and critical container vulnerabilities
findings.verification: Docker Scout SBOM indexed 52 packages and reported no vulnerable package after the Alpine/OpenSSL patch.
findings.remediation: Retain the pinned Alpine/OpenSSL versions and enforce the scanner in CI.

findings.title: External go-live trust and provider evidence absent
findings.verification: Local Caddy internal TLS and a persistent Docker Compose stack were verified; approved public trust, provider/device and signed go-live evidence were not available.
findings.remediation: Supply signed certificate, browser E2E, fiscal/printer/payment/provider, backup, licensing and security-assessment evidence.

findings.title: Hostname-free Caddy site rejects every TLS handshake
findings.verification: The localhost SAN/SNI site completed TLS 1.3 and returned HTTPS 200 for readiness and the UI root.
findings.remediation: Retain the explicit https://localhost identity and proxy HTTPS healthcheck until an approved deployment hostname and certificate replace local TLS.

findings.title: Compose environment and Windows CRLF break mounted-secret startup
findings.verification: Compose config and full restart succeeded without password environment interpolation; CRLF/LF normalization passed migration, Host, restart and persistence checks.
findings.remediation: Keep the password out of Compose Config.Env and retain the mounted-secret line-ending regression assertions.
